notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am glad to inform you that the demo version of the game is already available. The demo is small, basically like the game itself, but after playing it you will be able to roughly understand what the atmosphere of the game is.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2943960/extras/desc_foftfdemo.gif?t=1745490315[/img]

Only the first story chapter is available, the events of which unfold at a gas station and a roadside diner. The main location in the forest itself will appear only in the full version.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTyq6Bgc/itch-collage.jpg[/img]

Please leave feedback, including any bugs you find! ☺️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686250/Face_of_Fear_The_Forester_Demo/
